1. Added Aylin and Isobel being able to interact with Aradin outside Sorcerous Sundries

data.name: The Seal of R'lyeh
data.summary: A Lovecraftian expansion: the Occultist class (levels 1–20, four cults), two races – Innsmouth-Marked and Ghouls – a Wizard subclass, a skill tree for everyone, Eldritch Exposure & madness, and Withers' forbidden wares.

modfile.changelog:
Version 2.0 – "The Thousand Faces"

NEW CULT: CHURCH OF THE THOUSAND FACES (Nyarlathotep)
- Level 3: Dissonant Whispers, Charm Person, Mask of Many Faces (Disguise Self at will) and Seed of Discord.
- Level 6: The Black Man – when hit, show your true face as a reaction: the attacker is frightened and gains Eldritch Exposure.
- Level 10: The Black Pharaoh – once per long rest, deeply exposed enemies fight at your side.

NEW RACE: GHOULS
- Two subraces: Changeling and Dreamlands Ghoul. Grave Chill, Corpse Lore, Hunger and the Ghoul's Bite.
- Full appearance options in character creation, with a pale "Decay" skin by default.

NEW WIZARD SUBCLASS: SCHOOL OF FORBIDDEN LORE
- Copy Occultist spells into your spellbook (levels 2, 6 and 10).
- Marginalia, The Price of Knowledge, Mind at the Edge and The Necronomicon Opens.
- Added via Larian's progression merging – the Wizard's own data is not overwritten, so it works alongside other Wizard subclass mods.

LEVELS 13–20 (requires a level cap mod)
- The Occultist now has spell slots, spells and Forbidden Knowledge up to level 20.
- Five Mythic Rites: The Blasted Heath (13), Call the Star-Spawn (15), Dagon's Flood (17), The Gate and the Key (19), He Dreams No More (20).
- Level 17: No Mind Left to Lose. Level 20 capstone: The Seal Breaks.
- New cult features at level 14 for all four cults, and a second use of the level 10 power at level 18.

NEW 6TH-LEVEL SPELLS
- Call of a Shoggoth, The Hounds of Tindalos, The Shining Trapezohedron – plus Circle of Death, Eyebite and Harm.

LIBRARY OF MADNESS
- Fourth branch: Branch of the Thousand Faces – False Face, Whispered Discord, The Crawling Chaos, Face of the Messenger.

WITHERS' WARES (Act 2 & 3)
- Mask of the Yellow King (level 6), Mi-Go Carapace (level 8), Ring of the Trapezohedron (level 10).
- New consumables: Brine Vial (lowers Eldritch Exposure) and Dreamweed (advantage on Wisdom saves).

NEW BACKGROUND: SCHOLAR OF MISKATONIC
- Arcana and Investigation, plus seminar notes in your pack.

OTHER
- The Occultist now counts as both Wizard and Sorcerer for dialogue options.
- All new spells, items, races and classes have custom hand-drawn icons.

Existing saves work. Start a new character to play the Ghouls, the new background or the Wizard subclass.

data.name: Infinite Armory
data.summary: ~12,000 possible new weapons, armor and accessories with unique names, icons and abilities, scaled by act. Gather materials, craft items, sell to Volo in camp. Vendors carry more gold. All game languages. Safe mid-save.

modfile.changelog:
- 14 rings and gloves showed in the orange quest colour and could not be sold, because they borrowed the look of a quest item. They now use a normal look of the same type. Gear in your saves still loads.
- New items can now use about 100 more looks from the game, among them Sarevok's, the Dark Justiciar's and Githyanki gear, plus flails, mauls, pikes, war picks, javelins and light hammers.
- Six unique bard instruments, Lohse's lute among them, now appear as instrument looks.
- The catalogue grows to about 12,000 items.
- About 200 Mythic items: Legendary, with six powers each, including a signature power taken from the game's own legendary gear, and a grand name. Each Act 3 boss and vault has a 5% chance to drop one. They are never sold and cannot be crafted.
- Top-end weapon elements are now even: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Thunder, Acid, Poison, Necrotic, Psychic and Force weapons are as common as Radiant ones were. New elemental weapon powers: Emberbrand Strike, Stormcall Edge, Thunderclap Rider, Venomous Rider and Gravetouch Strike.
- New powers: Thunder and Force resistance; History, Investigation, Insight, Medicine and Animal Handling bonuses; Intelligence and Strength save bonuses; and flat +1/+2 boosts to every ability score.
- Unarmed-only powers (such as Martial Arts Lethality) no longer appear on weapons, bows, shields or instruments, where they could never work. About 130 existing items got a working power in their place.
- Items now look their rarity: Legendary and Very Rare gear wears the game's finer models instead of plain ones, and Uncommon gear no longer wears legendary-looking models. About 4,100 items got a new look, including some you may already own; each one is still the same kind of item with the same stats and powers.
- Unarmed and monk-style powers no longer roll on medium or heavy armour; about 120 items got a new power in their place.
- 20 more shield looks, among them The Bulwark, the Bonded, Steadfast and Death Knight shields. Also new: the Katana, the Death Knight longsword, the Merregon halberd, and Flaming Fist, city watch and Cult of the Absolute armour.
- About 75 items showed an icon of a different item (monk gloves shown as leather gloves, a stealth cloak as a plain cloak). Every item's icon now matches what it looks like when worn, and about 50 more items now get a themed icon.
